mapper.update: UPDATE s_wallet w JOIN ( SELECT o.user_id, o.amt_source, sum( o.order_amt ) order_amt, sum( o.result_amt ) result_amt FROM s_product_order o WHERE o.id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} GROUP BY o.user_id, o.amt_source) AS ot ON ot.user_id = w.user_id AND ot.amt_source = w.wallet_type set w.order_result_amt = IFNULL(w.order_result_amt,0) + ot.result_amt, w.order_amt = IFNULL(w.order_amt,0) + ot.order_amt, w.cash_able_amt = IF( GREATEST(w.to_be_order_amt - ot.order_amt,0) > 0,w.cash_able_amt,IF(w.balance = 0,w.cash_able_amt,w.balance)), w.to_be_order_amt = GREATEST(w.to_be_order_amt - ot.order_amt,0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_product_order_report ( report_date, user_id, product_id, platform_id, category, amt_source, user_suffix, order_count, order_amt, payout_amt, result_amt ) SELECT o.order_date, o.user_id, o.product_id, o.platform_id, o.category, o.amt_source, o.user_suffix, SUM(o.status) AS order_count, SUM(o.order_amt) AS order_amt, SUM(o.payout_amt) AS payout_amt, SUM(o.result_amt) AS result_amt FROM s_product_order o WHERE o.id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} GROUP BY o.order_date, o.user_id, o.product_id, o.platform_id, o.category, o.amt_source, o.user_suffix ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_count = order_count + VALUES(order_count), order_amt = order_amt + VALUES(order_amt), payout_amt = payout_amt + VALUES(payout_amt), result_amt = result_amt + VALUES(result_amt)

INSERT INTO p_user_proc (user_id, proc_type, proc_date, proc_time, proc_value, order_result_amt,order_times) SELECT o.user_id, 4, CURDATE(), NOW(), SUM(o.order_amt) order_amt, SUM(o.result_amt) result_amt, SUM(o.status) order_times FROM s_product_order o WHERE o.id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} GROUP BY o.user_id
